sections.text_helper: Section 24.4.5 "OPAMP initial configuration" in chapter 24 (Operational amplifier (OPAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 730.
sections.section_content:
By default (upon reset):
• The operational amplifier inputs INP/INM and output OUT are connected to I/O pins.
• The registers for offset compensation contain factory trimming values and are in
read-only access mode.
• The speed (slew rate) is set to normal.
• The timer-controlled operation of multiplexers is disabled.
• OPAMP is disabled.
